event.title: Ely Launch Event
event.description: Join Boundary Waters supporters and cyclists at Puddle Jumper Park in Ely as the Pedal to the Polls journey gets underway. Help us pack the park as we send Dave and Amy off on their journey! There will be food, great company, and the first opportunity to sign the canoe in support of permanent protection.

event.description: Join us at Heck Fest in Two Harbors! Hear from Amy and Dave Freeman about their journey across Minnesota, and learn how you can get involved in making a difference this election season.
